newsitem.title: USA: Kevco Inc sees Q2 even with yr-ago.
newsitem.headline: Kevco Inc sees Q2 even with yr-ago.

text.p: Kevco Inc said Wednesday that it believes earnings for its second quarter, ending June 30, will be about equal to the pro forma $0.39 per share it reported in the second quarter last year.

The year-earlier figure reflects adjustments for two acquisitions and the company's 1996 initial public offering. Kevco also said that despite a recent industry-wide decline in manufactured housing shipments, it sees improvement in the second half of the year because of favorable employment levels and mortgage rates.
The company earned $0.28 per share in the first quarter ended March 31.
Kevco is a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of building products for manufactured homes and recreational vehicles.
